name: MicroportMap project dataset schema

fields.name: Published project title
fields.infrastructureType: Reported project class; not necessarily the same as dock type
fields.reportedEquipment: Hardware and software mentioned by source

approximateMapPoint.latitude: Broad illustrative latitude, not facility coordinates
approximateMapPoint.longitude: Broad illustrative longitude, not facility coordinates

fields.reportDateLabel: Source publication timing, not operating status

limitations: No physical site count is implied by one record
